description: This file defines the interface CustomerAttributeService, which extends a generic entity service to handle operations related to CustomerAttribute entities in a customer management context. It declares methods for saving, updating, and retrieving customer attributes based on various identifiers.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeService
classes.description: An interface extending the generic sales manager entity service, providing methods to manage customer attribute data within a merchant store context.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists or updates a CustomerAttribute object; may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by merchant store, customer ID, and attribute ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes by merchant store and option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes by merchant store and attribute ID.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes associated with a specific customer in a merchant store.
